about.title: About Reactify Cheque Printer System
about.description: We are dedicated to simplifying cheque printing for Nepalese businesses.
about.storyP1: Reactify Cheque Printer System was born from a simple observation: Nepalese businesses spend too much time and effort on cheque printing. Traditional methods are often inaccurate, time-consuming, and frustrating.
about.storyP2: We set out to create a solution that would make cheque printing as simple as filling out a form. With pre-configured templates for all major Nepalese banks and precise alignment technology, we've helped hundreds of businesses streamline their payment processes.
about.missionDesc: To simplify cheque printing for every Nepalese business, making financial transactions faster and more accurate.
about.customersDesc: Every feature we build starts with our customers' needs. Your feedback drives our development.
about.qualityDesc: We ensure every template is precisely calibrated for accurate printing on every cheque.
about.visionDesc: To become Nepal's most trusted cheque printing platform, serving businesses of all sizes.
about.teamDescription: A dedicated team of developers, designers, and customer support professionals committed to making cheque printing effortless.

features.title: Features
features.description: Discover all the features that make RCPS the best choice for cheque printing.
features.preciseAlignmentDesc: Our templates are carefully calibrated to ensure your cheque details print exactly where they should, eliminating misalignment issues.
features.multipleBanksDesc: Support for all major Nepalese banks including Nabil, Global IME, Siddhartha, and more. Each template is designed to match the exact cheque dimensions.
features.secureDesc: Your cheque data is encrypted and stored securely. We never share your information with third parties.
features.historyDesc: Keep a complete record of all your printed cheques. Easily reprint or reference past transactions.
features.amountInWordsDesc: Automatic conversion of numerical amounts to words in both Nepali and English for Nepalese Rupees.
features.customizationDesc: Adjust template settings to match your specific printing needs and preferences.
features.exportDesc: Save your cheques as PDF files for digital records or sharing with your accounting team.
features.multiUserDesc: Allow multiple team members to access and print cheques with role-based permissions.
features.ctaDescription: Start your free trial today and experience the ease of RCPS.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about RCPS.
faq.a1: We support all major Nepalese banks including Nabil Bank, Global IME Bank, Siddhartha Bank, NIC Asia, Prabhu Bank, and many more. We're constantly adding new bank templates.
faq.q2: How accurate is the cheque printing?
faq.a2: Our templates are precisely calibrated to ensure accurate alignment. We test each template thoroughly to match the exact cheque dimensions of each bank.
faq.a3: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with 10 cheque prints. No credit card required. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time.
faq.q4: Can I print cheques in bulk?
faq.a4: Yes, our Business plan includes bulk printing features, allowing you to print multiple cheques at once. This is perfect for businesses with high-volume payment needs.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Your cheque information is stored securely and is never shared with third parties.
faq.a6: We offer email support for all plans, with priority support for Business plan users. You can reach us at support@reactify.com.np.
